name: Vertex-Deleted Three-Cube
definition: The subgraph of $Q_3$ induced by $\{0,1\}^3\setminus\{111\}$; every choice of the deleted cube vertex is isomorphic to this one.
properties: It is a partial cube, a daisy cube, an ample class, and a convex-geometry ideal, but it is not median: the coordinatewise majority of $110,101,011$ is the missing vertex $111$. Every proper pc-minor is median.
